title: Index of BitTorrent Enhancement Proposals
locator: Final and Active Process BEPs; Accepted BEPs; Draft BEPs
claim: Index assigns each BEP a Status (e.g. BEP3 Final; BEP5/6/9/10 Accepted; BEP7/32/40/47/52 Draft); the index Last-Modified date and Status must not be read as current deployment rate
conditions: index page only records status/version; no deployment data
limitations: index Last-Modified 2018 predates several listed docs; status is editorial

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: Handshake = 1 byte 19 + 'BitTorrent protocol' + 8 reserved zero bytes + 20-byte sha1 info-hash + 20-byte peer_id; mismatched info-hash or peer_id severs the connection
conditions: both sides must send identical info-hash

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: 'request' carries index/begin/length; all current implementations use 2^14 (16 kiB) blocks and close connections that request a larger amount
conditions: de-facto block size 16 kiB

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: piece length is almost always a power of two; most commonly 2^18 = 256K (mainline before 3.2 used 2^20 = 1M)

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: A multifile torrent is treated as a single concatenated file: files are concatenated in list order, so pieces can span file boundaries (BEP3 has no per-file alignment)
conditions: contrast with BEP52 which aligns each file to a piece boundary

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: Endgame: once requests for all wanted pieces are pending, the client sends requests to everyone; as each piece arrives it sends cancels to the others to avoid duplicate transfer
conditions: endgame only; causes duplicate bytes by design

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: Deployed choking changes only once every 10 s; unchokes the 4 peers with best download rate that are interested; a seed uses upload rate instead; one optimistic unchoke rotates every 30 s and new connections are 3x as likely to start
conditions: rate-based reciprocal choking

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: info_hash must be the hash of the encoded form as found in the .torrent; clients must either reject invalid metainfo or extract the substring, never do a decode-encode roundtrip on invalid data
conditions: key ordering and leading-zero rules

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
claim: Length-zero messages are keepalives and are ignored; keepalives are generally sent once every two minutes but timeouts can be shorter when data is expected

title: DHT Protocol
claim: Peer contact is encoded as a 6-byte string ('Compact IP-address/port info'): 4-byte IPv4 address + 2-byte port, both network byte order
conditions: IPv4 only

title: DHT Protocol
claim: Node contact is encoded as a 26-byte string ('Compact node info'): 20-byte Node ID + the 6-byte compact IP/port

title: DHT Protocol
claim: KRPC is one query packet to one response packet over UDP with no retry; the simple RPC has no built-in reliability
conditions: retry policy is the application's problem

title: DHT Protocol
claim: The token is the SHA1 of the querying node's IP concatenated with a secret that changes every five minutes; tokens up to ten minutes old are accepted
conditions: token must be presented to the same queried node

title: DHT Protocol
claim: get_peers returns either values (list of compact peer strings) or nodes (K closest nodes), and always a token required for a later announce_peer

title: DHT Protocol
claim: announce_peer requires the token and the queried node must verify it was sent to the same IP; optional implied_port=1 makes the node use the UDP source port instead of the port argument
conditions: implies NAT-aware peers accepting on the DHT port

title: DHT Protocol
claim: Buckets hold K=8 nodes; a node is 'good' if it responded to a query within the last 15 minutes; buckets not changed in 15 minutes should be refreshed; routing table should be persisted between runs
conditions: Kademlia XOR metric; 160-bit space

title: DHT Protocol
locator: Torrent File Extensions; BitTorrent Protocol Extension
claim: A trackerless torrent uses a 'nodes' key instead of 'announce'; DHT support is signalled by the last bit of the 8 reserved handshake bytes, and a PORT message (byte 0x09) advertises the DHT UDP port
conditions: bootstrap requires a reachable node

title: DHT Protocol
claim: A lookup contacts nodes closest to the infohash and iterates to closer nodes until no closer node exists; only after the search is exhausted does the client insert itself as a peer contact

title: Fast Extension
claim: Fast Extension is enabled by setting reserved[7] |= 0x04 and is active only if both ends set the bit
conditions: both peers must advertise

title: Fast Extension
claim: Have All = <len=0x0001><op=0x0E>; Have None = <len=0x0001><op=0x0F>; exactly one of Have All, Have None, or Have Bitfield MUST appear immediately after the handshake
conditions: fast extension enabled; disabled peer receiving them MUST close

title: Fast Extension
claim: Suggest Piece = <len=0x0005><op=0x0D><index>; advisory ('you might like this piece'); intended for super-seeding without throughput reduction and to keep roughly equal piece copies
conditions: advisory only; may be ignored

title: Fast Extension
claim: Every request is guaranteed to yield EXACTLY ONE response (piece or reject), even after cancel; choke no longer implicitly rejects pending requests; receiving an unsolicited piece MUST close the connection
conditions: fast extension enabled

title: Fast Extension
claim: Reject Request = <len=0x000D><op=0x10><index><begin><length>; on send of choke the peer MUST reject all requests (except allowed-fast pieces); excessive requests from a choked peer MAY cause disconnect

title: Fast Extension
claim: Allowed Fast = <len=0x0005><op=0x11><index>; means the piece will be served even while choked, to shorten the start-up ramp; current k=10 pieces

title: Fast Extension
claim: Canonical set: x = 0xFFFFFF00 & ip, append infohash, iterated SHA1, then index = y % sz, unique until k; no provisions for IPv6 (uses IPv4 only)
conditions: IPv4-only algorithm; the spec itself states no IPv6 provisions

title: IPv6 Tracker Extension
claim: An announce should be made for each local IP address the client listens on, using that address as the connection source address (bind before connect), for TCP HTTP/HTTPS and UDP trackers alike
conditions: multi-homed clients; key SHOULD be stable per infohash and have >=32 bits entropy

title: IPv6 Tracker Extension
claim: In compact mode the tracker MAY add peers6; peers6 has the same layout as peers but uses 18 bytes per endpoint instead of 6, all IPv6
conditions: compact response requested

title: IPv6 Tracker Extension
claim: The older &ipv4=/&ipv6= HTTP announce parameters are now discouraged because they let an attacker announce a victim's IP for DDoS

title: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files
claim: The extension transfers only the info-dictionary ('the metadata'), which is validated by the info-hash; it is handled in 16KiB (16384-byte) blocks indexed from 0, last block may be smaller
conditions: magnet/dht peers

title: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files
claim: Advertised via extension protocol: 'ut_metadata' entry in the m dictionary, plus 'metadata_size' (integer) at the top level of the extension handshake
conditions: BEP10 required

title: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files
claim: Three message types: request=0, data=1, reject=2, keyed by msg_type and piece; an unrecognized message ID MUST be ignored (forward compatibility)

title: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files
claim: A peer that does not have the entire metadata MUST respond with reject; a data message appends the raw piece after the bencoded dict (length prefix MUST include it), non-last pieces MUST be exactly 16KiB

title: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files
claim: Clients MAY implement flood protection by rejecting requests after a certain number (typically number of metadata pieces times a factor)

title: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files
claim: v1 magnet uses xt=urn:btih:<40-hex or 32-char base32>; v2 uses xt=urn:btmh:<multihash hex>; tr and x.pe may repeat; xt is the only mandatory parameter; without a tracker the client SHOULD use the DHT

title: Extension Protocol
authors: Arvid Norberg; Ludvig Strigeus; Greg Hazel
claim: Extension protocol support is advertised by reserved_byte[5] & 0x10 (bit 20 counting from 0)

title: Extension Protocol
authors: Arvid Norberg; Ludvig Strigeus; Greg Hazel
claim: After the flag, one new message is defined: 'extended' with message id 20; its payload starts with a single byte extended message id where 0 = handshake, >0 = extension as specified in the handshake

title: Extension Protocol
authors: Arvid Norberg; Ludvig Strigeus; Greg Hazel
claim: The m dictionary maps extension names to LOCAL extended message IDs; IDs are per-peer; a value of 0 disables that extension; subsequent handshakes are additive (send only CHANGES)

title: Extension Protocol
authors: Arvid Norberg; Ludvig Strigeus; Greg Hazel
claim: reqq is an integer for the number of outstanding request messages the client supports without dropping any; the default in libtorrent is 250
conditions: value is peer-specific
limitations: libtorrent default, not a protocol constant

title: Extension Protocol
authors: Arvid Norberg; Ludvig Strigeus; Greg Hazel
claim: Optional items: p (local TCP listen port), v (client name/version), yourip (compact 4- or 16-byte address), ipv6 (16-byte compact), ipv4 (4-byte compact)

title: Extension Protocol
authors: Arvid Norberg; Ludvig Strigeus; Greg Hazel
claim: The extension handshake should be sent immediately after the standard BitTorrent handshake; it is valid to send it again during the connection and the peer should not be disconnected

title: Peer Exchange (PEX)
claim: PEX introduces a ut_pex message via the extension protocol (BEP10); payload keys: added, added.f, added6, added6.f, dropped, dropped6
conditions: BEP10 negotiated
limitations: BEP11 defines dropped as 'one or more contacts in IPv6 compact format' although dropped is the IPv4 list — spec wording is inconsistent

title: Peer Exchange (PEX)
claim: added.f/added6.f are 1 byte per peer: 0x01 prefers encryption, 0x02 seed/upload_only, 0x04 supports uTP, 0x08 ut_holepunch support, 0x10 outgoing connection/reachable

title: Peer Exchange (PEX)
claim: A peer must only be put in added once a connection is successfully established, and in dropped once disconnected; sending added without a later dropped is non-compliant

title: Peer Exchange (PEX)
claim: Clients must batch updates to send no more than 1 PEX message per minute

title: Peer Exchange (PEX)
claim: Except for the initial PEX message the combined added v4/v6 contacts should not exceed 50 entries; the same applies to dropped entries

title: Peer Exchange (PEX)
claim: If a client has fewer than 25 live connections in an address family, the liveness requirement is relaxed: it may keep up to 25 most recently established fully-handshaken connections and include locally-initiated disconnect reasons in added/added6
conditions: per-address-family exemption

title: Peer Exchange (PEX)
claim: PEX data must be considered untrusted; clients should not take all candidates from a single PEX source and should ignore duplicate IPs; Canonical Peer Priority can spread connection attempts

title: Multitracker Metadata Extension
claim: announce-list is a list of lists (tiers) in the main area (not info); if present the client ignores the single 'announce' key and uses only announce-list URLs

title: Multitracker Metadata Extension
claim: Tiers are processed sequentially: all URLs in a tier must be tried before the next tier; URLs within a tier are shuffled once and then parsed in order; a successful tracker is moved to the front of its tier

title: Local Service Discovery
claim: LSD uses SSDP-like HTTP-over-UDP multicast on 239.192.152.143:6771 (IPv4) and [ff15::efc0:988f]:6771 (IPv6)
conditions: LAN-local; TTL may need raising

title: Local Service Discovery
claim: Announce format: 'BT-SEARCH * HTTP/1.1' with Host (multicast group), Port, Infohash (40-char hex) and optional cookie headers; multiple consecutive Infohash headers allowed and the packet should stay <=1400 bytes

title: Local Service Discovery
claim: A client participating in a swarm should send an LSD announce every 5 minutes on each listening interface, and no more than 1 announce per minute
conditions: rate limit to avoid multicast storms

title: Local Service Discovery
claim: On receiving an announce the client determines the remote contact IP from the UDP source address
conditions: implies the source address is the reachable one

title: UDP Tracker Protocol for BitTorrent
claim: connect request protocol_id is the magic constant 0x41727101980 (64-bit); the tracker replies with a connection_id that must be re-presented

title: UDP Tracker Protocol for BitTorrent
claim: IPv4 announce request is 98 bytes: connection_id, action=1, transaction_id, 20-byte info_hash, 20-byte peer_id, downloaded/left/uploaded, event, IP, key, num_want, port; v4 announce response is interval/leechers/seeders then 6-byte IP+port stride

title: UDP Tracker Protocol for BitTorrent
claim: IPv6 announces reuse the v4 structure but the response stride is 18 bytes instead of 6; the request IP field stays 32-bit and should be 0; format is chosen by UDP address family; dual-announcing clients should use the same key for v4 and v6
conditions: address-family selected by the UDP packet

title: UDP Tracker Protocol for BitTorrent
claim: If no response is received the client should retransmit after 15 * 2^n seconds with n starting at 0 and increasing up to 8 (3840 seconds); a connection ID must be re-requested when it expired
conditions: n<=8 bound

title: UDP Tracker Protocol for BitTorrent
claim: A connection ID can be used for multiple requests; a client can use it until one minute after receipt and trackers should accept it until two minutes after it was sent

title: UDP Tracker Protocol for BitTorrent
claim: Scrape request can carry up to about 74 torrents (20-byte info_hash each); a full scrape cannot be done with this protocol; scrape response gives seeders/completed/leechers per info_hash

title: WebSeed - HTTP/FTP Seeding (GetRight style)
claim: url-list is a new key in the main area (not info); it holds one or more URLs; the key may be safely ignored by clients that cannot use it

title: WebSeed - HTTP/FTP Seeding (GetRight style)
claim: If the url-list URL ends in '/', the client must append the torrent 'name'; for multi-file torrents url-list is a root folder to which the 'name' and 'path/file' are appended

title: WebSeed - HTTP/FTP Seeding (GetRight style)
claim: HTTP supports byte-range requests to resume or fetch specific ranges, whereas FTP can only say where to start the download
conditions: web seed has no BitTorrent block concept

title: WebSeed - HTTP/FTP Seeding (GetRight style)
claim: If a piece downloaded from an HTTP/FTP server fails the SHA checksum, the connection must be closed and that URL discarded
conditions: integrity mismatch is fatal for that URL

title: WebSeed - HTTP/FTP Seeding (GetRight style)
claim: A client need not discard an HTTP/FTP server URL if it gets a 'busy' reply

title: WebSeed - HTTP/FTP Seeding (GetRight style)
claim: Web-seed-friendly piece selection changes rarest-first to 'pretty rare with biggest distance from another completed piece' and, past 50% completion, occasionally fills the smallest gap; HTTP/FTP starts at the beginning of the biggest gap
conditions: implementation guidance, not mandated

title: Extension for partial seeds
authors: Arvid Norberg; Greg Hazel; Aaron Grunthal
claim: A partial seed SHOULD include 'upload_only' = 1 in the extension handshake; value 1 means the peer is not interested in downloading anything
conditions: BEP10 handshake
limitations: upload_only is defined in BEP21, not in BEP10 itself

title: Extension for partial seeds
authors: Arvid Norberg; Greg Hazel; Aaron Grunthal
claim: If the tracker supports this extension it MUST add a fourth scrape field 'downloaders' (active downloaders, excluding partial seeds); partial seeds = incomplete - downloaders
conditions: tracker support required

title: Extension for partial seeds
authors: Arvid Norberg; Greg Hazel; Aaron Grunthal
claim: To tell the tracker it is a partial seed, the peer MUST send event=paused in every announce while it is a partial seed
conditions: so a backup tracker can recover swarm state

title: Tracker Returns Compact Peer Lists
claim: Compact format represents each peer in only 6 bytes: first 4 bytes the 32-bit IPv4 address, remaining 2 bytes the port number, both network byte order
conditions: IPv4 only

title: Tracker Returns Compact Peer Lists
claim: compact=0/1 in the announce URL is only advisory (a tracker may return either format) but clients MUST continue to support both the dict-list and compact formats

title: Private Torrents
claim: A torrent is marked private by 'private=1' in the info dictionary

title: Private Torrents
claim: On seeing private=1 a client MUST ONLY announce itself to the private tracker and MUST ONLY initiate connections to peers returned from the private tracker (no DHT/PEX/LSD discovery)
conditions: hard requirement

title: Private Torrents
claim: With multiple trackers in announce-list of a private torrent each peer MUST use only one tracker at a time and switch only when the current fails; on switch it MUST disconnect from all current peers and connect only to the new tracker's peers

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: Version-1 uTP header: type, version, extension, connection_id (16 bits each), timestamp_microseconds, timestamp_difference_microseconds, wnd_size, then seq_nr and ack_nr (16 bits each); all big-endian

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: Packet types: ST_DATA=0, ST_FIN=1, ST_STATE=2 (ACK with no data), ST_RESET=3, ST_SYN=4; ST_SYN initialises seq_nr=1 and a random connection_id; the return path uses connection_id+1

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: Extension type 1 is Selective ACK: a bitmask of at least 32 bits in multiples of 32; the first bit represents ack_nr+2; it is only sent when at least one sequence number was skipped

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: Loss detection: if the oldest unacked packet has 3 or more packets acked past it (via SACK), or 3 duplicate acks arrive, the packet is assumed lost; on loss max_window is multiplied by 0.5
conditions: TCP-like multiplicative decrease

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: timeout = max(rtt + rtt_var*4, 500) ms (minimum 1/2 second); initial timeout 1000 ms; on timeout packet_size and max_window are set to the smallest size (150 bytes) to restart, and the timeout doubles for consecutive timed-out packets

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: uTP adjusts packet size down to as little as 150 bytes per packet on slow links and uses large packets at high rates
conditions: overhead grows at small sizes

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: CCONTROL_TARGET (accepted buffering delay on the up-link) is set to 100 ms; base_delay is a sliding minimum over the last two minutes; off_target = CCONTROL_TARGET - our_delay drives window growth
conditions: delay-based control; ideal buffer utilisation 0

title: uTorrent transport protocol
claim: max_window is increased by scaled_gain = MAX_CWND_INCREASE_PACKETS_PER_RTT * (off_target/CCONTROL_TARGET) * (outstanding_packet/max_window); if max_window < 0 it is clamped to 0 and a timeout forces one packet

title: BitTorrent DHT Extensions for IPv6
claim: There are two distinct, independent DHTs (IPv4 and IPv6): no IPv6 data is stored in the IPv4 DHT and vice versa; a node participating in both must maintain two routing tables; a node should use the same node id in both

title: BitTorrent DHT Extensions for IPv6
locator: New parameters; Changes to existing parameters
claim: nodes6 carries compact IPv6 node info for the 8 closest good IPv6 nodes; the 'want' parameter governs nodes ('n4') / nodes6 ('n6'); values is 6-octet IPv4 or 18-octet IPv6 and a hybrid values list (mixing 6- and 18-octet) must be parseable though implementations must not send one in a reply to an IPv4 request without a want parameter

title: BitTorrent DHT Extensions for IPv6
claim: The announce_peers syntax is unchanged, so an announce sent over IPv4 may only advertise an IPv4 address and one sent over IPv6 may only advertise an IPv6 address

title: BitTorrent DHT Extensions for IPv6
claim: A node obeying this spec MUST NOT send UDP datagrams with a payload larger than 1024 octets and must be able to receive datagrams of 1024 octets or less
conditions: fits the 1280-byte IPv6 minimum MTU

title: Canonical Peer Priority
claim: priority = crc32-c(sort(masked_client_ip, masked_peer_ip)); if the IPs are equal, the port numbers are used instead
conditions: both peers must derive the same hash

title: Canonical Peer Priority
claim: IPv4 mask is FF.FF.55.55 by default; if the two IPs are in the same /16 use FF.FF.FF.55; if in the same /24 use the entire FF.FF.FF.FF
conditions: address-dependent mask

title: Canonical Peer Priority
claim: IPv6 mask starts FFFF:FFFF:FFFF:5555:5555:5555:5555:5555 and becomes FFFF:FFFF:FFFF:FF55:5555:5555:5555:5555 in /48 and FFFF:FFFF:FFFF:FFFF:5555:5555:5555:5555 in /56

title: Canonical Peer Priority
claim: For client 123.213.32.10 and peer 98.76.54.32 the shared hash is crc32-c(624C14007BD50000) = ec2d7224
conditions: test vector for the crc32-c reference

title: Canonical Peer Priority
claim: Prioritisation should be used within torrents only (not globally); this spec is not intended to influence how peer slots are divided among torrents

title: Padding files and extended file attributes
claim: attr is a variable-length string whose characters mark file attributes: l = symlink, x = executable, h = hidden, p = padding file; unknown characters should be ignored

title: Padding files and extended file attributes
claim: Padding files are synthetic files inserted to let the following file start at a piece boundary; their content is all zeros for piece-hash calculation; aware clients need not write them to disk but must still service requests covering them
conditions: backwards compatibility

title: Padding files and extended file attributes
claim: The recommended padding-file path is ['.pad', 'N'] where N is the length in base10

title: Padding files and extended file attributes
claim: The l attribute marks a symlink; symlink path is the target relative to the torrent root; a symlink has length 0 (kept for backwards compatibility but clients should not require it)

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: piece length must be a power of two and at least 16KiB; it sets the granularity of piece/request/bitfield/have; each non-empty file is aligned to a piece boundary and the last piece of each file may be shorter (creating an alignment gap)
conditions: contrasts with BEP3 concatenated layout

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: file tree is a tree of dicts keyed by UTF-8 path elements, with a zero-length key holding properties; presence of 'length' means a file; 'pieces root' is the root hash of a merkle tree of branching factor 2 over 16KiB blocks (SHA2-256 in meta version 2); identical files always yield the same root hash
conditions: meta version 2

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: meta version is an integer set to 2; implementations must check this field first and indicate a too-new version before other validations
conditions: version 1 is unassigned

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: The v2 infohash is SHA2-256 over the bencoded info dictionary, truncated to 20 bytes for trackers; verification must also check that piece layers hashes match the pieces root fields

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: piece layers is a dict outside the info dict holding, for each file larger than the piece size, the concatenated hashes of one merkle layer chosen so one hash covers piece length bytes; a torrent is invalid if the field is absent or hashes do not match the pieces roots or are not from the correct layer

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: The v2 wire adds message ids 16 reject, 21 hash request, 22 hashes, 23 hash reject; hash request carries pieces root, base layer, index, length and proof layers; hash requests may be sent regardless of choke state

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: Every request is answered with either a piece or a reject; if an unsolicited piece is received a peer MUST close the connection

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: For BEP3 interoperability a hybrid torrent contains both formats: the pieces field and files/length must describe the same data in the same order; since the old format does not align files to piece boundaries a multifile hybrid torrent must use BEP47 padding files
conditions: hybrid/dual-format

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: When initiating a connection and sending the sha1 infohash of a hybrid torrent a peer can set the 4th most significant bit in the last byte of the reserved bitfield to indicate it also supports the new format; the remote peer may respond with the new infohash to upgrade
conditions: hybrid only

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification v2
claim: Implementations supporting both formats must validate that content (file names, order, piece alignment) is identical and verify pieces against both hash formats; on inconsistency they may abort or fall back to one format

title: Holepunch extension
claim: ut_holepunch is advertised via the extension protocol (BEP10); payload: msg_type (1 byte), addr_type (0x00 ipv4 / 0x01 ipv6), addr (4 or 16 bytes), port (2 bytes), err_code (4 bytes)
conditions: requires BEP10 and BEP29

title: Holepunch extension
claim: Message types: 0x00 rendezvous (relay sends connect to both initiating and target peer); 0x01 connect (initiate a uTP connection to the designated endpoint); 0x02 error

title: Holepunch extension
claim: Error codes: 0x01 NoSuchPeer, 0x02 NotConnected, 0x03 NoSupport, 0x04 NoSelf; the addr_type/addr/port fields in an error MUST match the rendezvous message

title: Holepunch extension
claim: On receiving a connect message each peer initiates a uTP connection to the other; it is possible that both uTP connection attempts succeed simultaneously
conditions: requires both peers to support uTP

title: Holepunch extension
claim: A target peer unwilling to connect SHOULD ignore the connect silently and MUST NOT send an error; if the initiator did not advertise ut_holepunch the relay MUST ignore incoming ut_holepunch messages silently; if already connected both MUST ignore silently
conditions: when not applicable: no support advertised, no connection to target, target is self, already connected

title: Low Extra Delay Background Transport (LEDBAT)
authors: S. Shalunov; G. Hazel; J. Iyengar; M. Kuehlewind
claim: RFC 6817 is an Experimental document: 'This document defines an Experimental Protocol for the Internet community', not an Internet Standards Track specification
conditions: experimental status
limitations: must be kept distinct from uTP implementation choices in BEP29

title: Low Extra Delay Background Transport (LEDBAT)
authors: S. Shalunov; G. Hazel; J. Iyengar; M. Kuehlewind
claim: TARGET MUST be 100 milliseconds or less; using the same TARGET across LEDBAT flows enables equitable bottleneck sharing
conditions: uTP BEP29 sets its own 100 ms target; the two documents are independent

title: Low Extra Delay Background Transport (LEDBAT)
authors: S. Shalunov; G. Hazel; J. Iyengar; M. Kuehlewind
claim: ALLOWED_INCREASE SHOULD be 1; GAIN MUST be <= 1; BASE_HISTORY SHOULD be 10; LEDBAT is designed to be no more aggressive than standard TCP (RFC 5681) and to yield quickly to competing TCP flows
conditions: background/scavenger traffic

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for Unicast UDP
claim: Defines three UDP mapping behaviors: Endpoint-Independent Mapping (reuse for any destination), Address-Dependent Mapping (reuse only for same destination IP), Address and Port-Dependent Mapping (reuse only for same destination IP:port)
conditions: terminology basis for NAT traversal

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for Unicast UDP
claim: A NAT UDP mapping timer MUST NOT expire in less than two minutes; a default of five minutes or more is RECOMMENDED
conditions: well-known destination ports may have shorter timers

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for Unicast UDP
claim: The NAT mapping Refresh Direction MUST have outbound refresh behavior True; inbound refresh MAY also be True
conditions: outbound refresh keeps the client's mapping alive

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for Unicast UDP
claim: Defines Endpoint-Independent, Address-Dependent and Address-Port-Dependent Filtering; REQ-8: endpoint-independent filtering is recommended when application transparency matters, address-dependent filtering when security matters more
conditions: filtering and mapping are independent axes

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for Unicast UDP
claim: A NAT MUST support hairpinning with an external source IP address and port so two endpoints behind the same NAT can communicate using each other's external addresses

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for Unicast UDP
claim: A NAT MUST have deterministic behavior: it must not change translation or filtering behavior at any point or under any condition (no primary/secondary/tertiary behavior switching)
conditions: non-deterministic NATs are hard to troubleshoot

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for Unicast UDP
claim: Receipt of any sort of ICMP message MUST NOT terminate the NAT mapping; blocking ICMP Destination Unreachable is strongly discouraged

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for TCP
authors: S. Guha; K. Biswas; B. Ford; S. Sivakumar; P. Srisuresh
claim: REQ-1: a NAT MUST have Endpoint-Independent Mapping behavior for TCP (necessary for UNSAF traversal so an internal endpoint can learn and advertise one external IP:port)
conditions: TCP mapping, distinct from UDP

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for TCP
authors: S. Guha; K. Biswas; B. Ford; S. Sivakumar; P. Srisuresh
claim: REQ-2: A NAT MUST support all valid TCP packet sequences for internally- and externally-initiated connections, including the simultaneous-open mode (accept an inbound SYN plus an outbound SYN-ACK for an internally initiated connection)
conditions: P2P hole punching prerequisite

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for TCP
authors: S. Guha; K. Biswas; B. Ford; S. Sivakumar; P. Srisuresh
claim: REQ-4: A NAT MUST NOT respond to an unsolicited inbound SYN for at least 6 seconds; if an outbound SYN for the connection is then translated it MUST silently drop the original SYN, otherwise it SHOULD send ICMP Port Unreachable
conditions: silent drop aids simultaneous-open

title: NAT Behavioral Requirements for TCP
authors: S. Guha; K. Biswas; B. Ford; S. Sivakumar; P. Srisuresh
claim: REQ-5: the 'established connection idle-timeout' MUST NOT be less than 2 hours 4 minutes and the 'transitory connection idle-timeout' MUST NOT be less than 4 minutes
conditions: so keep-alives at the 2-hour default rate keep a mapping alive

conditions: FluxDown 未设置该选项时取默认 128

title: pinned rqbit: 请求窗口的运行时判定条件
claim: can_send_request() 返回「未被对端 choke」且「requested_inflight_count() < request_window」；requested_inflight_count 就是 LivePeerState::inflight_requests（HashSet<ChunkInfo>）的长度，即窗口单位是 chunk 请求而不是 piece。
conditions: 每个 peer 独立计数

title: pinned rqbit: extended handshake 的 reqq 会下调窗口
claim: 收到扩展握手且 reqq>0 时 request_window = reqq.min(state.max_request_window())，仅在数值变化时写入并 notify_request_slots_changed()；因此对端声明的 reqq 只会把窗口压到 128 以下，不会上调。
conditions: 对端支持扩展握手并声明 reqq
limitations: 本端只在扩展握手中上报 v/yourip/metadata_size，不上报自己的 reqq

title: pinned rqbit: 每 peer 的请求流水线循环
claim: task_peer_chunk_requester 先 wait_for_bitfield()，循环内 update_interest(true) → wait_for_request_slot() → acquire_next_piece() → 对每个 chunk 再 wait_for_request_slot() 并 prepare_for_download 限速 → add_inflight_request(chunk) → 发送 Request；取不到片时最多等 5 秒或被 new_pieces_notify 唤醒；该任务结束时 peer 断开。
conditions: 每 peer 一个 requester 任务
limitations: 限速等待穿插在窗口判定之间，受限速时窗口占用会被拖长

title: pinned rqbit: max_request_window 的配置下发链
claim: session 把 PeerConnectionOptions.max_request_window 与 add-torrent 级选项合并（other.max_request_window.or(self.peer_opts.max_request_window)）后写入 ManagedTorrentOptions.peer_max_request_window，再由 TorrentStateLive::max_request_window 消费；链路上无额外默认值覆盖。

title: pinned rqbit: 不存在 choke 算法，连接建立即无条件 Unchoke
claim: writer 任务启动时在发送 bitfield 之后无条件写出 Message::Unchoke，之后不再发送任何 Choke；对 Message::Choke 的引用只出现在接收解析路径（torrent_state/live/mod.rs:1475 的 on_i_am_choked 与 peer_binary_protocol 的编解码表），没有任何发送 Choke 的代码路径。
conditions: 所有已建立连接，含入站与出站
limitations: 因此 pinned rqbit 没有 tit-for-tat、没有周期性 rechoke、也没有 optimistic unchoke，不存在按上传贡献决定 choke 谁

title: pinned rqbit: 对端 choke 只作为本端请求的门控
claim: acquire_next_piece 首先检查 self.is_choked()（初值 true），choked 时直接返回 Ok(None) 不取片；on_i_am_choked/on_i_am_unchoked 只翻转 PeerFlowControl.i_am_choked 这一个布尔位，不触发重排也不取消已有在途请求。
conditions: 本端作为下载方
limitations: 已发出的在途请求在被 choke 后不会被主动取消

title: pinned rqbit: 上传需求由 peer_interested 标记而非 choke 表达
claim: 收到 Interested 只置 live.peer_interested=true 并维护 interested_peers 聚合；收到 NotInterested 时把该 peer 的待发上传全量丢弃（upload_queue.drop_peer）并刷新 upload_queue_depth。对端是否被本端 choke 不参与判断，因为本端从不下发 Choke。
conditions: 本端作为上传方

title: pinned rqbit: 上传请求队列的两级硬上限
claim: MAX_PENDING_PER_PEER=128（覆盖排队的与已交给 writer 的请求）、MAX_PENDING_PER_TORRENT=4096；超 per-peer 上限返回 PeerBacklogExceeded 并由 on_download_request 返回 anyhow 错误从而断开该 peer，超 per-torrent 上限返回 TorrentBacklogExceeded 同样报错。
conditions: 两个上限都是常量，不随配置变化
limitations: per-torrent 上限被顶满时错误只说明 backlog full，无法区分是哪个 peer 造成的

title: pinned rqbit: 上传调度按 peer 轮转、peer 内 FIFO
claim: pop_next 从 rotation（VecDeque<SocketAddr>）弹出队首 peer，取该 peer 队列的首个请求；若该 peer 仍有剩余请求则把它重新压回 rotation 尾部，否则从 peers 映射中移除。轮转单位是 peer，单个 peer 内部是 FIFO。
conditions: rotation 在 enqueue 时按 peer 去重追加
limitations: 没有按 piece 优先级或请求年龄的排序，也没有跨 torrent 调度

title: pinned rqbit: 上传队列的去重 / 取消 / 代际失效
claim: enqueue 用 (piece,begin,length) 做 RequestKey 去重，重复请求返回 Duplicate 且不计入 upload_requests；cancel 只能删除尚未交给 writer 的请求；drop_peer 在对端 NotInterested/断开时清空该 peer；drop_stale_generations 在重连时按 generation 丢弃上一代连接的挂起请求。
conditions: 每个请求带 generation
limitations: 已经在写的请求无法取消

title: pinned rqbit: 上传调度任务的单点循环
claim: task_upload_scheduler 是每 torrent 单任务：从队列 pop_next（空则 await upload_notify），解析 peer 的 writer 通道，依次做 torrent 级与 session 级 prepare_for_upload 限速，复核 generation 后把 ReadChunkRequest 交给该 peer 的 writer 去读盘并发送。
conditions: 限速在 torrent 与 session 两级串行叠加
limitations: 时间戳与读盘发生在 peer 自己的 writer 任务里，调度器只排队不读盘

title: pinned rqbit: AggregatePeerStats 的完整字段集
claim: AggregatePeerStats 由 gen_stats! 生成，字段为 queued/connecting/live/live_tcp/live_utp/live_socks/live_seeders/seen/dead/not_needed/steals/candidate_rejected/interested_peers/useful_peers/incoming_rejected/admission_rejected，全部为原子 u32，快照为 Relaxed load。
limitations: 没有握手阶段的 attempts/successes/failures 字段，也没有按发现来源（tracker/DHT/PEX/LSD）的字段

title: pinned rqbit: seen 是「曾建立过 peer 记录」的历史计数
claim: add_if_not_seen 只在 DashMap 的 Vacant 分支（该地址首次出现）时 atomic_inc(stats.seen) 与 atomic_inc(session_stats.seen)；入站连接的 add_incoming_peer 也在 Vacant 分支加 seen。因此 seen 是累计的去重地址数，与当前 live 数无关，且不会因 peer 死亡而减少。
conditions: 同一地址在 Dead→Queued 重排时不重复计入
limitations: seen 不等于握手成功数，也不等于曾成功传输的 peer 数

title: pinned rqbit: 连接阶段的计数点与语义
claim: PeerHandler::on_connected 同时累加 per-peer counters.outgoing_connections、counters.total_time_connecting_ms、torrent 级 stats.connection_successes 与 stats.total_connecting_ms；它是 transport 连接成功回调，不区分 BT 握手是否成功。
conditions: 出站连接成功回调
limitations: connection_successes 是 transport 层成功数，adapter 与文档都不得把它当作 BT 握手成功率

title: pinned rqbit: useful peer 的 1 MiB 阈值与作用方向
claim: USEFUL_PEER_BYTES = 1024*1024，useful_peers 统计的是「从我们这里取走至少 1 MiB 的 peer 数」，阈值由上传方向决定而不是下载方向；该聚合在 peer 首次跨阈值时 +1、断开时 -1。
limitations: FluxDown 侧 BtPeerStats.useful_peers 直接透传该字段，其注释写作「fetched at least 1 MiB」，与实际方向不同

title: pinned rqbit: 逐 peer 快照 API 已存在但未被 FluxDown 使用
claim: TorrentStateLive::per_peer_stats_snapshot(filter) 返回 PeerStatsSnapshot，以地址字符串为键并支持按 PeerState 过滤，且经 librqbit::api 与 HTTP handler 暴露；但 FluxDown 的 native/engine 未调用它（在 native/ 下检索无命中）。
limitations: pinned 版本的 PeerStatsSnapshot 不含发现来源与握手阶段字段

title: pinned rqbit: TCP/uTP 竞速与失败原因归并
claim: connect() 先无条件发起 TCP；若 uTP 可用则等 1 秒或 TCP 失败信号后再发起 uTP（注释写明 Give TCP priority as it is more mature and simpler）；两者先成功者胜；两者都失败时按组合返回 Error::Connect / TcpConnect / UtpConnect / ConnectDisabled；代理配置存在时直接走 SOCKS 分支不参与竞速。
conditions: enable_tcp 为 false 时 uTP 立即开始
limitations: 竞速耗时会被计入 total_connecting_ms 与 transport attempts

title: pinned rqbit: 按 transport 与地址族的连接统计
claim: ConnectStatsAtomic 结构为 { tcp, utp, socks } × { v4, v6 }，每个 SingleStat 含 attempts/successes/errors；with_stat 在发起前 attempts(1)、成功后 successes(1)、失败后 errors(1)，族由 addr.is_ipv6() 决定。
limitations: 这是 transport 层统计，不含 MSE/BT 握手结果

title: pinned rqbit: MSE 模式与明文回退
claim: MseMode 有 Disabled/Enabled（默认）/Forced 三值；Enabled 下 MSE 失败会回退为明文重拨，Forced 下未完成 MSE 的对端被丢弃；PLAINTEXT_SNIFF_TIMEOUT=2s 用于在发送 Ya+PadA 后判定对端是明文 peer，避免等满整个读写超时。
limitations: MSE 不是带 BEP 编号的规范，此处为事实标准互操作实现；明文回退意味着 MSE 失败只表现为额外一次重拨，不产生稳定失败计数

title: pinned rqbit: 连接级超时的代码默认值
claim: PeerConnectionOptions 的 read_write_timeout 未设置时取 10s、keep_alive_interval 未设置时取 120s；connect_timeout 与 handshake_timeout 无代码内默认值（None 即不额外限制 / 回退到 read_write_timeout）。
conditions: None 的语义由调用方决定
limitations: FluxDown 覆盖了三项（10s/20s/10s），因此默认值只对不使用该覆盖的消费者成立

title: pinned rqbit: peer 轮换的四个阈值常量
claim: TURNOVER_MIN_PEER_AGE=30s、TURNOVER_MIN_IDLE=30s、TURNOVER_INTERVAL=60s、TURNOVER_LIVE_THRESHOLD_PERCENT=50；注释明确写明候选若一直不产出会在生命最初一分钟内被轮换掉。这与 pinned commit 标题「收缩 peer 轮换的判定窗口到一分钟内」一致。
conditions: 常量为编译期值，不可配置

title: pinned rqbit: turnover 的触发条件与淘汰量
claim: maybe_turnover_peers 仅在有等待候选（pending_candidate 或队列非空）、live 数达到 live_limit 的 50%、且距上次运行超过 60s 时运行；单次预算为 max(1, ceil(live/25))（约 4%）；被淘汰 peer 置为 PeerState::NotNeeded，属策略断开，不记网络错误也不安排 backoff 重试。
conditions: per-torrent；live_limit 来自 TorrentAdmission
limitations: 函数文档注释写 at or above 90% of the per-torrent cap，与代码常量 50% 不一致，以代码常量为准

title: pinned rqbit: 可被轮换的 peer 判定条件
claim: turnover_eligible 需同时满足：连接时长 >= 30s；最近 30s 内既无下载也无上传 payload；requested_inflight_count()==0（我们对该 peer 无在途请求）；peer_interested==false。任一不满足即不可被轮换。

title: pinned rqbit: 存储层是同步设计且使用 positioned vectored IO
claim: storage 显式设计为同步而非 async：目的是避免 tokio::fs 的每文件 2MB 缓冲带来的 memcpy 与内存膨胀，并对下载路径直接用 peer socket 缓冲写入文件、对上传路径直接读到 peer socket 缓冲；写路径使用 positioned vectored pwritev，使同一文件可无锁并行写。
limitations: 同步存储意味着写盘阻塞发生在调用线程；该模块本身不提供写队列深度或背压计数器

title: pinned rqbit: sparse 只在 Windows 生效
claim: mark_file_sparse 使用 FSCTL_SET_SPARSE，整份 sparse.rs 被平台 cfg 限定为 Windows；FilesystemStorage 的 pwrite_all / pwrite_all_vectored / ensure_file_length 在 windows 分支调用 try_mark_sparse()、非 windows 分支直接写。因此 Linux/macOS 上不存在该 sparse 标记逻辑。
conditions: Windows only
limitations: FluxDown 的 bt_sparse 包装正是在此之上补足 init 阶段的标记时机

title: pinned rqbit: session 级计数器只有四个
claim: SessionCounters 只含 fetched_bytes / uploaded_bytes / blocked_incoming / blocked_outgoing 四个 u64，均为 session 生命周期累计；SessionStats 另持有 AggregatePeerStatsAtomic、5 样本的上下行 SpeedEstimator 与 startup_time。
conditions: session 级
limitations: session 计数器不随单个 torrent 暂停而重置，也不按 torrent 拆分

title: pinned rqbit: live_epoch 是跨 pause/resume 累加的唯一对齐手段
claim: StatsSnapshot.live_epoch 是进程级单调 id，同一 torrent 的 uploaded_bytes 只在单个 live 实例内累计、暂停/恢复会归零；字段文档明确要求跨 pause/resume 累加的消费者必须用该 id 作为基线键，否则无法区分计数器归零与没有新上传。
limitations: connection_attempts/successes/errors/total_connecting_ms/peer_stats.steals 同样是 per live 实例累计，不是进程级

title: pinned rqbit: Prometheus 导出复用同一指标名导致 seen 覆盖 queued
claim: as_prometheus 连续两次写出名为 rqbit_peers_queued 的 gauge（先 self.peers.queued，再 self.peers.seen），因此 seen 在 Prometheus 输出中无法被单独读取；同时 useful_peers、interested_peers、incoming_rejected、admission_rejected、upload_queue_depth、uploading_peers 均未被导出。
conditions: 仅 Prometheus 文本导出路径
limitations: 这是可观测性缺陷而非语义设计；JSON 快照路径不受影响

title: FluxDown BT_PEER_LIMIT 区间常量与其依据注释
claim: BT_PEER_LIMIT_MIN/MAX/DEFAULT = 128/512/256；注释记录 #825 实测：6.9GB 公开种子下 128 上限被约 120 个连接中尝试占满、只剩 5-10 个可用 peer，提升到 512 后稳态 1.1 → 12.6 MB/s、RSS 增加约 15 MB。
conditions: 该注释描述上限语义为「连接中与已连接共用同一个信号量」
limitations: 该机制描述是上游单信号量语义；当前 build_opts 已注入 peer_admission 拆分预算，注释里的机制归因与现状不匹配

title: FluxDown 连接中与会话级 peer 邻居量
claim: BT_PEER_CONNECT_LIMIT_MIN/MAX/DEFAULT = 32/256/64（每 torrent 出站连接中）；BT_SESSION_PEER_LIMIT_MIN/MAX/DEFAULT = 128/4096/1024（会话级逻辑 peer）。

title: FluxDown 由会话预算派生 connecting 预算的公式
claim: bt_session_connect_limit(session)=(session/4).clamp(1,128)，默认 1024/4=128；组合到 rqbit 侧后 session_connect_limit=128 经 connecting_reserve=16 得到出站连接中共享额度 connecting_outbound=112，而 per-torrent connecting 上限为 64。
conditions: 默认配置；公式对 128..4096 全区间生效
limitations: 若 session_peer_limit 取到 clamp 下界以下，/4 的结果会被下界 1 覆盖

title: FluxDown build_opts 实际下发的会话参数全集
claim: build_opts 下发：listen 模式由 enable_utp 决定 TcpAndUtp/TcpOnly、listen_addr 由 ipv4_only 决定 [::]/0.0.0.0、enable_upnp_port_forwarding=enable_upnp；connect.enable_tcp=true；peer_opts connect_timeout=10s / read_write_timeout=20s / handshake_timeout=10s / connect_rate=30；peer_limit=Some(peer_limit)；peer_admission{session_peer_limit, torrent_connect_limit=peer_connect_limit, session_connect_limit=bt_session_connect_limit(..)}；peer_backoff{min 5s, factor 4.0, max 600s, total 1800s}；concurrent_init_limit=3；fastresume=true；mse_mode 由配置映射。
limitations: peer_backoff 的 total_delay=1800s 表示累计失败 30 分钟后出池，与 rqbit 默认（10s/6x/3600s/24h）不同

title: FluxDown 未设置请求窗口，实际取 rqbit 默认 128
claim: PeerConnectionOptions 只显式设置了 connect_timeout / read_write_timeout / handshake_timeout / connect_rate，其余字段用 ..Default::default()；其中 max_request_window 未设置，因此 FluxDown 运行时的请求窗口等于 rqbit 的 DEFAULT_PEER_REQUEST_WINDOW=128，并被对端 reqq 单向下调。
limitations: 注释中的 Optimised peer connection parameters 只覆盖超时与速率，不含流水线深度

title: FluxDown 监听端口探测与双栈降级顺序
claim: probe_listener_port 先 TcpListener::bind 到 0.0.0.0:port 并立即 drop，AddrNotAvailable/Unsupported 视为可继续（注释说明 IPv6-only 主机仍可用双栈候选）；start_session 对 port_start..=port_end（默认 6881..=6891）逐端口先尝试双栈再尝试 ipv4_only，is_retryable_listener_error 决定是否继续降级。
limitations: 探测只覆盖 TCP 绑定可行性，不代表 uTP/UDP 端口可达，也不代表 UPnP 映射成功

title: FluxDown 的 DHT bootstrap 与持久化配置
claim: 开启 DHT 时下发 bootstrap_addrs = router.bittorrent.com:6881、router.utorrent.com:6881、dht.transmissionbt.com:6881、dht.libtorrent.org:25401，并持久化到 app data 目录的 dht.json（dump_interval=DHT_PERSIST_DUMP_INTERVAL）；注释记录 router.bitcomet.net 已被移除。
conditions: dht=false 时 dht 字段为 None，完全关闭 DHT

title: FluxDown 中新 torrent 的实际 peer_limit 取值路径
claim: build_add_torrent_options 使用编译期常量 BT_PEER_LIMIT_DEFAULT；真正的新增下载走 build_add_torrent_options_with_peer_limit(.., shared_bt.peer_limit.load(Relaxed))，即用运行时原子值，并经 normalize_bt_peer_limit 夹到 128..512。
limitations: SessionOptions.peer_limit 只在建会话时取一次，与 add 时的 per-torrent 值互相独立

title: FluxDown 的 BtPeerStats 聚合口径与截断方式
claim: bt_peer_stats_from_handle 只读一次 live.stats_snapshot() 并把聚合直接映射到 BtPeerStats：seen/queued/connecting/live/dead/live_tcp/live_utp/live_socks/useful_peers/connection_{attempts,successes,errors}/total_connecting_ms/fetched_bytes/downloaded_pieces/total_piece_download_ms/peer_steals/uploaded_bytes/uploading_peers/interested_peers/upload_requests/upload_queue_depth/incoming_rejected/admission_rejected；三个 u64 连接计数用 u32::try_from(..).unwrap_or(u32::MAX) 钳制而非回绕。
conditions: 每个采样点一次
limitations: 注释说明这样做是为了避免逐 peer 建 map 的分配，因此没有任何 per-peer 明细越过该边界

title: FluxDown 在无 live 句柄时把整块 BT 统计置为 None
claim: bt_peer_stats_from_handle 首行 handle.live()? 返回 None 时整个函数返回 None；bt_runtime 用 bt_peer_stats.map(|s| s.live) 得到 connected_peers，因此非 BT 或句柄已释放时字段保持 None 而不写 0。
limitations: pinned rqbit 的 per_peer_stats_snapshot 未接入，故窗口内贡献 peer 与逐 peer 明细在 engine 层不可达

title: FluxDown 共享 BT 会话的惰性创建
claim: ensure_bt_session 在 bt_config.enabled 为假时返回 BT_DISABLED_MESSAGE 错误；否则清空 bt_paused_idle_since 并在 bt_session 为 None 时用 tokio::task::spawn_blocking 调用 SharedBtSession::new（注释说明该函数内部 Runtime::block_on 不能在 tokio 运行时内调用），建好后立刻 seeding_manager().set_cap(seed_max_active)。
limitations: spawn_blocking + block_on 意味着建会话会占用一个阻塞线程

title: FluxDown set_bt_config 的热生效边界
claim: set_bt_config 对已存在的 session 只做两件事：seeding_manager().set_cap(config.seed_max_active) 与 bt.set_peer_limit(config.peer_limit)，然后整体替换 self.bt_config；端口、DHT、tracker 以及 peer_admission 的预算（bt_peer_connect_limit / bt_session_peer_limit）都只在 session 构造时读取，需 invalidate_bt_session 重建才生效。
conditions: 函数文档明确写出该边界

title: FluxDown set_peer_limit 对已运行 torrent 是否生效
claim: SharedBtSession::set_peer_limit 只把 normalize 后的值写进 AtomicUsize；该原子仅在构造 AddTorrentOptions 时被 load（readd_for_seeding 与新增下载两处）。因此改 peer_limit 只影响此后 add 的 torrent，对已存在的 torrent 句柄不生效。
limitations: set_bt_config 的文档注释称 the live bt_peer_limit take effect on the running session immediately，与「仅影响后续 add」的实际行为存在口径冲突

title: FluxDown invalidate_bt_session 的清理范围
claim: invalidate_bt_session 先 park_pending_bt_tasks，再收集 active_tasks 中 is_bt 的 id；对 seeding_manager().all_task_ids() 中每个 id 执行 unregister_seeder，把 seed_time_secs 落库并写 SeedingStopReason::SessionReleased，随后发送任务进度事件并优雅暂停活跃 BT 任务。
conditions: 存在活跃 BT 任务时

title: FluxDown SeedingManager 的槽位与 FIFO 语义
claim: cap=0 表示不限制，has_free_slot 即 cap==0 || active_len<cap；register 返回 Activated / Queued（需调用方 pause torrent）/ AlreadyPresent 三态；QueuedSeed 不保留上传检查点（排队项处于暂停态，解除暂停会产生新的 live 实例）。

title: FluxDown 做种槽位的重平衡算法
claim: reconcile 在有空闲槽位时按 FIFO 从 queued 提升到 active，超上限时降级 most recently activated 的活跃项并把它塞回队首，被降级项返回结算后的累计做种秒数供调用方落库；因此裁剪策略是后进先出而不是按上传贡献。

title: FluxDown 的 parts 边车与其存储工厂
claim: 边车文件为 <task_id>.parts（与 librqbit 会话数据同目录），内容是选中文件到最终磁盘路径的映射加跨文件边界 piece 落在未选文件内的字节区间；续种 re-add 时注入 PartsSeedStorageFactory，选中文件直接映射到最终路径打开（绝不 create），未选文件读写全部路由到边车 blob；加载时校验 info-hash 与 file_id 数量，不匹配即拒绝。
conditions: 完成后的续种路径

title: FluxDown Windows sparse 包装与 TypeId 伪装
claim: SparseFsStorage::init 先委托 FilesystemStorage::init，再在 set_len 之前对所有非 padding 文件调用 mark_sparse（FSCTL_SET_SPARSE），注释说明这是打标记的唯一正确窗口；is_type_id 同时对 FilesystemStorageFactory 与自身返回 true 以通过 JSON session 持久化的 TypeId 白名单，依据是 session.json 每次启动先于会话创建被整体清除。
conditions: 仅 Windows 编译

title: FluxDown 的 MSE 开关模型
claim: BtMseMode 为 Disabled/Enabled（Default）/Forced，解析时 trim 后大小写不敏感匹配，非法值一律回落 Enabled；映射到 librqbit::MseMode 是一一对应；默认值由 BtConfig::default 给出（Enabled），注释说明这是应急逃生阀、不经 Settings UI。

title: Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent
claim: BitTorrent keeps typically five 16 kB sub-piece requests pipelined per connection to avoid stalls while waiting for round-trips.
limitations: Workshop paper, no experiments; describes the reference (mainline) design.

title: Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent
claim: A peer unchokes a fixed four peers by default, recomputes choke decisions every 10 s, and rotates a single optimistic unchoke every 30 s.
limitations: No measurement; defaults as of 2003.

title: Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent
claim: Anti-snubbing: if no piece is received from a peer for over a minute it is assumed snubbed and is not uploaded to except as an optimistic unchoke.

title: Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent
claim: Piece selection is rarest-first with a random-first exception until the first complete piece, plus an endgame mode that re-requests outstanding sub-pieces with cancels.

title: Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent
claim: Announcing held pieces produces less than a tenth of a percent of bandwidth overhead.

title: Rarest First and Choke Algorithms Are Enough
authors: A. Legout; G. Urvoy-Keller; P. Michiardi
claim: On 26 real torrents rarest-first yields close-to-ideal piece entropy: 70-80% of torrents have the median interest ratio near 1.
conditions: High-speed backbone, mainline client v4.0.2, upload capped at 20 kB/s.
limitations: Single instrumented client; 26 torrents, June 2005-May 2006; no repeatability.

title: Rarest First and Choke Algorithms Are Enough
authors: A. Legout; G. Urvoy-Keller; P. Michiardi
claim: A peer with fewer than 4 pieces selects pieces at random (random-first) and only then switches to rarest-first; a strict-priority block policy completes started pieces first.

title: Rarest First and Choke Algorithms Are Enough
authors: A. Legout; G. Urvoy-Keller; P. Michiardi
claim: The v4.0 seed-state choke algorithm unchokes by time-since-last-unchoke rather than by upload rate, which the authors report fixes the fairness problems of the old algorithm.
limitations: The new seed algorithm is undocumented outside the mainline client.

title: Rarest First and Choke Algorithms Are Enough
authors: A. Legout; G. Urvoy-Keller; P. Michiardi
claim: The authors conclude the latest choke algorithm is fair and robust to free riders and that replacing it with a bit-level tit-for-tat is not appropriate for Internet P2P replication.
limitations: Conflicts with simulation-based unfairness findings of Bharambe et al.

title: Rarest First and Choke Algorithms Are Enough
authors: A. Legout; G. Urvoy-Keller; P. Michiardi
claim: Endgame mode has little impact on overall performance because it is used only at the very end of a download.

title: Dissecting BitTorrent: Five Months in a Torrent's Lifetime
authors: M. Izal; G. Urvoy-Keller; E. W. Biersack; P. A. Felber; A. Al Hamra; L. Garces-Erice
claim: Only 19% of sessions completed the transfer, yet the 81% of incomplete sessions accounted for just 21.5% of downloaded bytes.
conditions: 1.77 GB Red Hat 9 tracker log, 181,847 sessions, Apr-Aug 2003.
limitations: Tracker-log based; departure times only for graceful departures; single torrent.

title: Dissecting BitTorrent: Five Months in a Torrent's Lifetime
authors: M. Izal; G. Urvoy-Keller; E. W. Biersack; P. A. Felber; A. Al Hamra; L. Garces-Erice
claim: Seeds contributed more than twice the volume uploaded by leechers; the seed fraction stayed above 20% and peaked near 40% in the first five days.

title: Dissecting BitTorrent: Five Months in a Torrent's Lifetime
authors: M. Izal; G. Urvoy-Keller; E. W. Biersack; P. A. Felber; A. Al Hamra; L. Garces-Erice
claim: More than 85% of the file was sent by only 20 peers, including 8 seeds that alone provided 40% of the file.
conditions: Instrumented campus client, one run mid-lifetime.
limitations: Single client run; not repeatable.

title: Dissecting BitTorrent: Five Months in a Torrent's Lifetime
authors: M. Izal; G. Urvoy-Keller; E. W. Biersack; P. A. Felber; A. Al Hamra; L. Garces-Erice
claim: Upload and download throughputs are uncorrelated (correlation near 0) although transfer volumes are positively correlated (about 0.5).

title: Dissecting BitTorrent: Five Months in a Torrent's Lifetime
authors: M. Izal; G. Urvoy-Keller; E. W. Biersack; P. A. Felber; A. Al Hamra; L. Garces-Erice
claim: A newly joined client needs roughly a 100 s warm-up before it holds chunks it can reciprocate, after which upload and download grow together.

title: Analyzing and Improving a BitTorrent Network's Performance Mechanisms
authors: A. R. Bharambe; C. Herley; V. N. Padmanabhan
claim: In a simulated Red Hat workload BitTorrent reached 91% mean uplink utilization, but with heavy load skew across peers.
conditions: Discrete-event simulator, 200 MB file, 400 blocks of 256 kB, 1 seed, 1000 leechers, edge-bottleneck only.
limitations: Simulation only; no packet-level TCP, no endgame mode, no interior bottlenecks.

title: Analyzing and Improving a BitTorrent Network's Performance Mechanisms
authors: A. R. Bharambe; C. Herley; V. N. Padmanabhan
claim: Some clients uploaded 6.26x as many blocks as they downloaded, so the rate-based tit-for-tat policy does not prevent unfairness in heterogeneous swarms.

title: Analyzing and Improving a BitTorrent Network's Performance Mechanisms
authors: A. R. Bharambe; C. Herley; V. N. Padmanabhan
claim: About 50% of blocks served by a 400 kbps seed were premature duplicates; a smartseed policy (no choke on an incomplete block, least-served block first) avoids the waste.

title: Analyzing and Improving a BitTorrent Network's Performance Mechanisms
authors: A. R. Bharambe; C. Herley; V. N. Padmanabhan
claim: Local rarest-first beats random block selection only when node degree is large enough (d=7 or 15) and seed bandwidth is low; with a high-bandwidth seed the two are equivalent.

title: Analyzing and Improving a BitTorrent Network's Performance Mechanisms
authors: A. R. Bharambe; C. Herley; V. N. Padmanabhan
claim: A pairwise block-level tit-for-tat bounds the extra blocks served by a node to d*Delta and removes unfairness, at some cost to uplink utilization when node degree is low.

title: Modeling and Performance Analysis of BitTorrent-Like Peer-to-Peer Networks
claim: The fluid model gives average download time T = 1/(theta+beta), independent of the peer arrival rate lambda, i.e. the system scales very well.
conditions: Deterministic fluid model; homogeneous upload bandwidth; global-knowledge assumption for the incentive analysis.
limitations: Fluid/Markovian model, not measurements; ignores node degree and max concurrent uploads.

title: Modeling and Performance Analysis of BitTorrent-Like Peer-to-Peer Networks
claim: File-sharing effectiveness eta = 1-(log N/N)^k is very close to 1 for realistic piece counts, so BitTorrent shares pieces efficiently.

title: Modeling and Performance Analysis of BitTorrent-Like Peer-to-Peer Networks
claim: Because of optimistic unchoking a zero-upload free rider still obtains about 1/(n_u+1)=20% of the maximum downloading rate.
limitations: Analysis assumes global rate knowledge; real optimistic unchoke is local.

title: Modeling and Performance Analysis of BitTorrent-Like Peer-to-Peer Networks
claim: The steady state is locally stable: the linearised matrices have eigenvalues with strictly negative real parts in both bandwidth-limited regimes.

title: Do Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent?
authors: M. Piatek; T. Isdal; T. Anderson; A. Krishnamurthy; A. Venkataramani
claim: BitTyrant yields a median 70% download-performance gain for a 1 Mbit/s client on live Internet swarms.
conditions: Live swarms + PlanetLab; 301,595 observed IPs over 48 h in April 2006.

title: Do Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent?
authors: M. Piatek; T. Isdal; T. Anderson; A. Krishnamurthy; A. Venkataramani
claim: The median ratio of unmodified-Azureus to BitTyrant completion time is 1.72, and 25% of downloads finish at least twice as fast.

title: Do Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent?
authors: M. Piatek; T. Isdal; T. Anderson; A. Krishnamurthy; A. Venkataramani
claim: Reciprocation probability is essentially assured once a peer offers about 14 KB/s equal-split rate, so upload beyond that is altruistic.

title: Do Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent?
authors: M. Piatek; T. Isdal; T. Anderson; A. Krishnamurthy; A. Venkataramani
claim: Enlarging the local neighbourhood raises average protocol overhead only from 0.9% to 1.9% of file data.

title: Do Incentives Build Robustness in BitTorrent?
authors: M. Piatek; T. Isdal; T. Anderson; A. Krishnamurthy; A. Venkataramani
claim: Tit-for-tat converges slowly for high-capacity peers: a 6,400 KB/s peer transfers more than 4 GB before reaching steady state.

claim: P2P session lengths are fit by Weibull or log-normal distributions, not by the exponential or Pareto (not heavy-tailed; fitted alpha=2.1-2.7).
conditions: Gnutella/Kad snapshots + three BitTorrent tracker logs (Red Hat, Debian, FlatOut).

title: Understanding Churn in Peer-to-Peer Networks
claim: Prior reports of median peer session length vary dramatically, from one minute to one hour, largely due to measurement bias.

title: Understanding Churn in Peer-to-Peer Networks
claim: BitTorrent peers frequently linger for hours to days after completing a download, and this lingering dominates the session-length tail.
conditions: 16-61% of sessions completed within one session, depending on trace.

title: Understanding Churn in Peer-to-Peer Networks
claim: Tracker logs contain large gaps (up to 8 h in the Red Hat log), so analysis must be restricted to the largest contiguous segment.

authors: D. Stutzbach; R. Rejaie; N. Duffield; S. Sen; W. Willinger

authors: D. Stutzbach; R. Rejaie; N. Duffield; S. Sen; W. Willinger

title: On Unbiased Sampling for Unstructured Peer-to-Peer Networks

claim: MRWB remains nearly unbiased as long as peers maintain at least three connections; below that, degree changes introduce error.

authors: R. Cuevas; G. Siganos; X. Yang; N. Laoutaris; P. Rodriguez

authors: R. Cuevas; G. Siganos; X. Yang; N. Laoutaris; P. Rodriguez

authors: D. Rossi; C. Testa; S. Valenti; L. Muscariello

claim: Two LEDBAT flows that start at t=0 share a bottleneck fairly (F>0.99) and efficiently (within 0.7% of the TCP case).

authors: D. Rossi; C. Testa; S. Valenti; L. Muscariello

authors: P. Richter; F. Wohlfart; N. Vallina-Rodriguez; M. Allman; R. Bush; A. Feldmann; C. Kreibich; N. Weaver; V. Paxson

limitations: 已知偏差: 换用 cake_mq 会改变流量处理路径；不能据此推出: 增大 memlimit 能提升吞吐

title: Universal TUN/TAP device driver (Documentation/networking/tuntap.rst)
topic: 内核-TUN/TAP 路径与 qdisc 背压
locator: §3.2 Frame format; §3.3 Multiqueue tuntap interface; §3.4 qdisc backpressure
claim: IFF_BACKPRESSURE 使内核在内部 ring buffer 满时停止队列而非丢包，从而让已附加 qdisc 的 AQM/整形/公平性真正生效（无此标志时 TX 丢包发生、已附加的 qdisc 事实上被绕过，应用只能从丢包感知拥塞）；该标志是设备属性而非 fd 属性，适用于设备的所有队列，且设备超过 1 个队列后无法再修改
conditions: 条件: 需要已附加 qdisc，noqueue 下无效；时间范围: 文档含 2024 年后新增的 backpressure 小节，无版本戳；许可: 文件头 SPDX GPL-2.0
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档指出在单个 TUN/TAP 队列上并行多流时该标志可能因背压开销降低性能；已知偏差: 文档建议可同时减小 txqueuelen 把缓冲转移到 qdisc 以减少 bufferbloat，但可能带来性能代价；不能据此推出: 使用 TUN 类代理即代表 qdisc 生效

title: fallocate(2) — manipulate file space
topic: 内核-文件预分配与稀疏语义
locator: §Allocating disk space; §Deallocating file space; §Zeroing file space; §HISTORY
claim: 默认 mode 的 fallocate() 为区间分配磁盘空间并把此前无数据的子区域初始化为零，成功返回后对该区间的后续写入保证不会因磁盘空间不足失败；FALLOC_FL_KEEP_SIZE 不改变文件大小（用于 append 负载的优化）；FALLOC_FL_PUNCH_HOLE（Linux 2.6.38 起）制造空洞且必须与 FALLOC_FL_KEEP_SIZE 按位或使用；分配以块为单位，可能分配比请求更大的范围
conditions: 条件: 依赖文件系统支持（文档列出 XFS 2.6.38 / ext4 3.0 / Btrfs 3.7 / tmpfs 3.5 等）；时间范围: 无版本戳；许可: missing（man7 页面未在同页声明许可）
limitations: 已知偏差: hole punching / zero range 的支持范围随文件系统不同；不能据此推出: 预分配成功等于数据已持久化到稳定存储（持久化语义另见 fsync 族文档）

title: lseek(2) — SEEK_HOLE / SEEK_DATA
topic: 内核-稀疏文件空洞探测语义
locator: §Seeking file data and holes (lines 62-105); ENXIO (140-142); STANDARDS (169-171)
claim: SEEK_DATA / SEEK_HOLE 自 Linux 3.1 起可用，用于映射稀疏文件的空洞；文档明确文件系统没有义务报告空洞，因此这不是「实际已分配存储空间」的保证机制（最简单的实现可以让 SEEK_HOLE 恒返回文件末尾、SEEK_DATA 恒返回 offset）
conditions: 条件: 需定义 _GNU_SOURCE；支持文件系统列表随版本（Btrfs 自 3.1 等）；时间范围: 无版本戳；许可: missing（man7 页面未在同页声明许可）
limitations: 已知偏差: 已真正写入的零序列可能不被报告为空洞；不能据此推出: SEEK_HOLE 的位置等于磁盘上未分配的块

title: getrlimit(2) / setrlimit(2) / prlimit(2)
topic: 内核-进程文件描述符上限
claim: RLIMIT_NOFILE 指定「可打开的最大 fd 号加一」，超过该值的 open/pipe/dup 等调用会失败；既有软限与硬限，非特权进程提高硬限会被拒绝；调用者若试图把硬 RLIMIT_NOFILE 提高到 /proc/sys/fs/nr_open 之上会得到 EPERM
conditions: 条件: 软限/硬限语义不同，prlimit 可对任意进程读写；时间范围: 无版本戳；许可: missing（man7 页面未在同页声明许可）
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档 BUGS 小节记录 spurious ENFILE 等历史行为；不能据此推出: 提高软限即等于内核会允许（受 nr_open 与内存约束）

title: ABI/stable/sysfs-block (block queue sysfs attributes)
topic: 内核-块设备队列可观测与可调属性
locator: What: /sys/block/<disk>/inflight (94-97); queue/iostats (424); queue/max_sectors_kb (489); queue/nomerges (540); queue/nr_requests (553); queue/rotational (649); queue/rq_affinity (656); queue/scheduler (670); queue/wbt_lat_usec (709)
claim: 这些是内核 stable ABI 中定义、供运行期读取/设置的块设备队列属性；其中 inflight 报告设备驱动中正在进行（pending/in-flight）的 I/O 请求数（读、写各一），文档指出该值与 queue/nr_requests（以及 SCSI 设备的 queue_depth）相关
conditions: 条件: 各属性的可读写性以条目标注（[RO]/[RW]）为准；时间范围: 条目 Date 从 2003 到 2024 不等；许可: missing（本次内容未含许可行）

title: Optimize for Doze and App Standby
topic: 移动端-Android 省电机制对网络的影响
locator: §Understand Doze; §Doze restrictions; §Support for other use cases
claim: 设备在未插电、静止且熄屏一段时间后进入 Doze；Doze 期间系统挂起应用的网络访问、忽略 wake lock、把 AlarmManager 标准闹钟（含 setExact/setWindow）推迟到下一维护窗口、不做 Wi-Fi 扫描、不运行 sync adapter、不运行 JobScheduler；系统周期性进入维护窗口放行挂起活动，且随时间推移调度频率下降
conditions: 条件: Android 6.0（API 23）及以上对所有应用生效，与 targetSdk 无关；部分应用可被列入 battery optimization 豁免名单（可维持网络与 partial wakelock）；时间范围: 未标版本戳；许可: developer.android.com Content License
limitations: 已知偏差: 厂商 ROM 可能叠加额外限制，文档未覆盖；不能据此推出: 声明为前台服务即可无条件保持网络活跃（另有 FGS 启动与执行时限约束）

title: Doze/App Standby — App Standby 的网络放行频率
claim: 系统把无近期用户交互（且无前台进程、无用户可见通知）的应用判为 idle；设备长时间空闲时系统允许 idle 应用大约每天获得一次网络访问；接入电源会把应用从 standby 释放，让其自由访问网络并执行挂起的 job/sync
conditions: 条件: 判定依赖「用户近期交互/前台进程/可见通知」三项否条件；时间范围: 未标版本戳；许可: developer.android.com Content License
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档只给「约每天一次」，具体频率由系统决定；不能据此推出: 后台 BT 会话可在 App Standby 下保持持续活跃

title: Foreground service types
topic: 移动端-Android 前台服务类型约束
claim: Android 14（API 34）起每个前台服务必须声明 service type 并申请对应权限（此外仍需 FOREGROUND_SERVICE）；dataSync 类型（FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC）用于数据上传/下载、备份恢复、导入导出等，且「无运行时前置权限」；mediaProcessing 类型由系统给出运行时限，正常情形为每 24 小时中 6 小时，且该限制由应用所有 mediaProcessing 前台服务共享
conditions: 条件: 面向 API 34+ 的 targetSdk；时间范围: 页面反映 Android 14/15 行为；许可: developer.android.com Content License
limitations: 已知偏差: dataSync 的替代路径与超时行为需另读迁移指南（本次未获取）；不能据此推出: 声明 dataSync 即可无限期后台下载（Android 15 起对 dataSync 前台服务另有上限约束，本 slice 未核对）

title: Data transfer background task options
topic: 移动端-Android 数据传输 API 选择与时限
locator: §Common background data transfer scenarios（对照表）; §Use WorkManager for data transfer
claim: WorkManager 适用于时长小于 10 分钟、应在应用不可见时执行的可延迟任务；由用户发起且需让用户看到进度的传输应使用 user-initiated data transfer job；长于 10 分钟的 worker 需借助前台服务，并因此受与前台服务相同的限制，且超过 10 分钟的 job 会被系统重调度
conditions: 条件: 选择依据「是否用户发起 / 是否须立即执行」；时间范围: 页面 Last updated 2026-02-26；许可: developer.android.com Content License

title: Read network state
topic: 移动端-Android 网络能力 API 语义
claim: NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET 只表示网络「已被配置为可访问互联网」，是配置而非实际可达能力（可能仍处于 captive portal）；文档称 NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED 是系统能给出的「实际可达」最近似指标，但仍可能遭遇基于 IP 的过滤或信号劣化导致的突然失联
conditions: 条件: 读取状态无需特定权限，但绑定后台网络等操作需要 CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE；时间范围: 未标版本戳；许可: developer.android.com Content License
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档自陈 VALIDATED 只是最近似结论，不保证真实可达；不能据此推出: 网络具备 INTERNET capability 即可建立到任意 peer 的连接（NAT、防火墙、BT 端口映射另论）

title: Read network state — 默认网络切换的后果
topic: 移动端-Android 网络切换造成连接中断
claim: 当某新网络成为默认网络时，应用此后新开的连接走新网络，而此前默认网络上的所有剩余连接会被强制终止；系统通常偏好非计费（unmetered）网络与更快的网络；应用可注册 registerDefaultNetworkCallback 感知默认网络变更
conditions: 条件: 需要 NetworkCallback 才能及时感知；时间范围: 未标版本戳；许可: developer.android.com Content License
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档未给出强制终止的时间窗；不能据此推出: 长连接（含 BT peer 连接）能平滑迁移到新网络；不能据此推出: 切换只影响新连接

title: Background Tasks framework
topic: 移动端-iOS 后台任务框架
claim: 该框架用于在应用处于后台时维持内容更新并运行需要数分钟完成的任务；较长的任务在支持的设备上可利用外部电源、网络连接与 GPU；用法是注册框架提供任务的 launch handler 并按需调度（BGProcessingTask 为耗时数分钟的处理任务，BGAppRefreshTask 为短刷新任务）
conditions: 条件: iOS/iPadOS 13.0 起可用（framework availability）；时间范围: 文档版权 2026（当前版本）；许可: Apple 文档受 Apple Terms of Use
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档只声明「数分钟」，未给硬性上限；调度时机由系统决定，文档未承诺准点；不能据此推出: 注册任务即可按时或持续获得执行

title: Downloading files in the background (URLSession background sessions)
topic: 移动端-iOS 后台传输限制与限速
locator: §Configure the background session; §Comply with background transfer limitations; §Use background sessions efficiently
claim: 后台 session 的实际传输由独立于应用的进程执行，因此有限制：session 必须提供 delegate、仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS（不支持自定义协议）、重定向总被跟随且 willPerformHTTPRedirection 不会被调用、仅支持从文件发起的上传任务；系统对在后台启动新下载使用 rate limiter，每次 resume/relaunch 后延迟增加，应用回到前台时延迟重置为 0
conditions: 条件: 需用 background(withIdentifier:) 配置；isDiscretionary 让系统等待插电/Wi-Fi 等条件，earliestBeginDate 只保证不早于该时刻；时间范围: 文档版权 2026；许可: Apple Terms of Use
limitations: 已知偏差: 任务粒度开销存在，文档建议少量 session、多任务；不能据此推出: 后台下载会以全速持续进行；不能据此推出: 大量小任务比少量大任务更快

title: hdparm(8) — get/set ATA/SATA drive parameters
topic: 运行环境-机械盘电源管理与空闲唤醒
claim: -B 读写 Advanced Power Management 特性（若驱动器支持）：低值表示更激进省电、高值表示更好性能，取值 1–127；-S 设置 standby(spindown) 超时，取值 1–240 表示 5 秒的倍数（5 秒–20 分钟），241–251 表示 1–11 个 30 分钟单位，0 表示禁用超时；-C 查询当前电源模式（unknown / active/idle / standby / sleeping）
conditions: 条件: 需驱动器与固件支持相应命令；时间范围: manpage 未标版本戳；许可: missing（man7 页面未在同页声明许可）
limitations: 已知偏差: APM 级别与 spindown 超时的实际行为依固件/驱动而异；不能据此推出: 设置 -B 即可彻底避免空闲唤醒（APM 为建议性，后台 I/O 仍可唤醒）

title: nfs(5) — NFS client mount options
topic: 运行环境-NAS/NFS 挂载参数与吞吐相关项
claim: NFS READ/WRITE 单请求最大载荷为 1,048,576 字节（1 MiB）；未指定 rsize/wsize（或指定值超过任一端能力）时由客户端与服务端协商取双方支持的最大值；nconnect 允许在客户端与同一服务器 IP 之间建立最多 16 条连接（用于分摊负载）；未指定或指定 async 时客户端会延迟把应用写入发往服务端
conditions: 条件: 在 RTT 大、丢包或 MTU 受限环境中文档建议裁剪 rsize/wsize；时间范围: 参数随内核版本演进（文档含 max_connect 等较新项）；许可: missing（man7 页面未在同页声明许可）
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档指出 NFS over TCP 下 rsize/wsize 可安全使用最大值，而 UDP 环境需裁剪；不能据此推出: 提高 rsize/wsize 必然提高 NAS 吞吐（受链路 MTU、服务端实现与并发影响）

title: nfs(5) — soft/softerr 挂载的静默损坏风险
topic: 运行环境-NAS 超时语义与数据完整性
locator: Option soft / softerr / hard (lines 93-109); softreval (111-129); timeo (135-156); retrans (158-166)
claim: 文档明确：soft/softerr 挂载在 retrans 次重传后会让请求以 EIO（soft）或 ETIMEDOUT（softerr）失败，并且「所谓 soft 超时在某些情况下会导致静默数据损坏」，因此仅当客户端响应性比数据完整性更重要时才应使用；用 NFS over TCP 或提高 retrans 可缓解部分风险；默认（未指定 hard/soft）为 hard，即无限重试
conditions: 条件: 仅在显式选择 soft/softerr 时适用；时间范围: 未标版本戳；许可: missing（man7 页面未在同页声明许可）
limitations: 已知偏差: hard 模式在服务端永久宕机时会让相关操作无限重试（文档同时给出 softreval 等折中项）；不能据此推出: 使用 soft 是「以可用性换少量请求失败」的安全折中（文档说可能静默损坏）

title: RFC 5905: Network Time Protocol Version 4 — Protocol and Algorithms Specification
authors: Mills, D.; Martin, J. (Ed.); Burbank, J.; Kasch, W.
topic: 测量方法-时钟偏移与往返时延估计
locator: §8 On-Wire Protocol (theta/delta 公式); §10 clock filter (lambda = delta/2 + epsilon); §11.2 System Process (LAMBDA)
claim: 四时间戳公式：clock offset theta = 1/2 * [(T2-T1) + (T3-T4)]，round-trip delay delta = (T4-T1) - (T3-T2)；文档指出当路径不对称时会出现负的 delta（举例表观延迟 -6.4 ms），负值在后续计算中会误导结果，应被 clamp 到不小于系统精度 s.rho；根同步距离 LAMBDA = EPSILON + DELTA/2 被定义为「所有原因造成的最大误差」
conditions: 条件: 对等体间延迟路径的对称性是该估计可用性的前提（RFC 7679 §3.5 明确指出普通 NTP 的同步精度取决于所用 NTP 代理之间延迟性质的稳定性与对称性）；时间范围: 文档发布 2010-06，已被 RFC 7822/8573/9109/9748/9769 更新；许可: IETF Trust 文档（RFC 系列版权声明）
limitations: 已知偏差: 该规范给出的是协议算法与统计量，不是端到端实测误差界；不能据此推出: NTP 同步后跨主机时间戳相减可直接当作单向时延使用；不能据此推出: 由被测链路的 RTT 可无损推断 NTP 同步误差

title: RFC 7679: A One-Way Delay Metric for IP Performance Metrics (IPPM)
authors: Almes, G.; Kalidindi, S.; Zekauskas, M.; Morton, A. (Ed.)
topic: 测量方法-单向时延的时钟不确定度
locator: §2 General Issues regarding Time (234-268); §3.5 Discussion (321-333); §3.7.1 Errors or Uncertainties Related to Clocks (442-495); §3.7.2 Wire Time vs. Host Time (497-528)
claim: 单向时延的时钟相关总不确定度为 Esynch(t) + Rsource + Rdest（两端时钟同步误差上界 + 两端时钟分辨率之和），必须计入任何测量实现的误差分析；文档给出量级参考：GPS 可把同步做到数十微秒，而普通 NTP 应用可能只到数毫秒，且该精度取决于所用 NTP 代理之间延迟特性的稳定与对称；此外 host time 与 wire time 之差需单独计入（Hsource + Hdest）
conditions: 条件: 假设两端可被同步且可界定 Esynch(t)；时间范围: 发布 2016-01（STD 81）；许可: IETF Trust 文档（RFC 系列版权声明）
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档自陈其误差界是把各项不确定度相加得到的相对宽松上界；不能据此推出: 用未同步主机的时间戳相减得到的单向时延可用于比较跨主机性能；不能据此推出: 一次同步可以长期有效（skew 使 Tsynch 是时间的函数）

title: RFC 7679: 系统误差校准与 Poisson 随机采样
authors: Almes, G.; Kalidindi, S.; Zekauskas, M.; Morton, A. (Ed.)
topic: 测量方法-校准、报告与无偏采样
locator: §3.7.3 Calibration of Errors and Uncertainties (530-615); §3.8 Reporting the Metric (636-670); §4 Poisson stream (703-706, 782-786)
claim: 校准的目标是确定测量主机自身的系统与随机误差：measured value = true value + systematic error + random error，若能确定系统误差则应从报告值中扣除；报告应给出校准误差 e，使真值落在报告值 ±e 内的概率至少 95%，且 e 取重复测量偏差的 2.5/97.5 百分位绝对值最大者再加上时钟相关不确定度；校准需至少数百次重复，并且随机误差与测量负载相关（并行测多条路径会增加中断/调度/磁盘 I/O 带来的误差），因此除空载基线外还应在现场负载下校准；采样使用伪随机 Poisson 过程，「以避免自同步效应」并取得统计上尽量无偏的样本
conditions: 条件: 需已知或近似零时延的隔离网络段作为基线；时间范围: 发布 2016-01；许可: IETF Trust 文档（RFC 系列版权声明）
limitations: 已知偏差: 文档自陈并不主张真实 Internet 流量按 Poisson 到达，Poisson 只用于调度采样；已知偏差: 把各项不确定度相加得到的界偏保守；不能据此推出: 95% 覆盖率可保证任意单次测量准确

title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods — Full factorial example (replication / randomization)
topic: 测量方法-实验顺序随机化与重复的作用
claim: 随机化实验运行顺序用于防御无关外部因素影响结论：文档举例若按「四低四高」顺序运行而昼夜环境温度又影响响应，会错误地把环境效应归因于该因子，因此「尽可能随机化实验运行」；重复（replication）用于在同一设置下获得响应的离散度并检验方差齐性假设
conditions: 条件: 该页是 2^k 全因子示例，非 AB/BA 交叉设计专章；时间范围: 页面未标版本/日期；许可: missing（该页未声明具体许可条款）
limitations: 已知偏差: 示例领域为工业过程改进；已知偏差: 该页未覆盖顺序效应（period effect）与 carryover 的处理方法；不能据此推出: 随机化顺序可以替代对时间块内系统性漂移的建模
